name: Adjourned Agenda and Minutes
agenda_text:
AGENDA FOR THE
SAN DIEGO CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA FOR REGULAR COUNCIL MEETINGS
OF
MONDAY, APRIL 27, 2026
TUESDAY, APRIL 28, 2026
CITY ADMINISTRATION BUILDING
COUNCIL CHAMBERS – 12 TH FLOOR
202 “C” STREET
SAN DIEGO, CA 92101
---------------------------
The City Council meetings of April 27 and April 28 of 2026 have been adjourned, pursuant to the 2026 Legislative Calendar adopted by Resolution 316464 on October 21, 2025.
The next regularly scheduled meeting of the City Council is Monday, May 11, 2026, at 10:00 a.m., and Tuesday, May 12, 2026, at 10:00 a.m.
